items.name: quarkus-agent-mcp
items.description: A standalone MCP server that enables AI coding agents to create, manage, and interact with Quarkus applications. It runs as a separate process that survives app crashes, giving agents the ability to create projects, control application lifecycle (start/stop/restart), proxy Dev MCP tools, and search Quarkus documentation.
